chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurara, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'I am with the Imam, and I finish the recitation before he finishes.' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Retain one verse, glorify Allah, and praise Him. So when he finishes, recite the verse and bow.'
ai.seo_question: What should a worshipper do if they finish reciting before the Imam in congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines the practical procedure for a follower who finishes reciting before the Imam, instructing him to pause, glorify Allah, and wait for the Imam to conclude his recitation before completing his own and proceeding to ruku'. This ruling highlights the Shia emphasis on the synchronization of the congregation with the Imam's actions, ensuring unity in prayer while accommodating the individual's completion of obligatory recitations. It reflects the scholarly tradition of balancing personal obligation with communal harmony during congregational salāt.
